title: Speech and Hearing Sciences
sourceText:
BIOLOGY 102 [BSCI] or 106 [BSCI]

Communication [COMM] or Written Communication [WRTG]

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

PSYCH 105 [SSCI]

UCORE Inquiry
Must complete 3 of these 4 UCORE designations:  ARTS, DIVR, EQJS, HUM.

ENGLISH 101 [WRTG]

PHYSICS 101/111 [PSCI] or CHEM 101 [PSCI]

SHS Elective
SHS electives (17 credits required) include any H D or PSYCH course 200-level or above, or as approved by advisor.

STAT 212 [QUAN]

SHS 205

SHS Electives
SHS electives (17 credits required) include any H D or PSYCH course 200-level or above, or as approved by advisor.

Electives

Complete Writing Portfolio

SHS 371 [M]

SHS 372

SHS 375

SHS 377

SHS Upper Electives
SHS Upper Electives (25 credits) include any SHS courses not used to fulfill other requirements. Enrollment in either SHS 473 [M] or SHS 482 [M] required to meet University writing in the major requirements. SHS 482 [M] has prerequisites not met until completion of third-year courses.

SHS 376

SHS 378

SHS 478

SHS 479

SHS 490

SHS 461

SHS 480 [CAPS]

SHS Upper Electives

Admission Requirements:

Given the rigorous nature of the coursework and the need to prepare students for work in a pre-professional role or to prepare them for the competitive demands of applying to graduate school in the discipline, students must meet the following minimum requirements for admission to the major in Speech and Hearing Sciences:  1) Have earned a minimum of 24 credits; 2) Have taken, or is currently enrolled in, SHS 205, Introduction to Speech-Language Pathology & Audiology; 3)minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0. 

At least 45 of the total credits required for the bachelor’s degree in this program must be in 300-400-level courses. 

The Speech and Hearing Sciences Department provides preparation for professional (graduate) training as a speech-language pathologist or audiologist.  This course sequence is based on fall enrollment.  UCOREs must be completed prior to the fifth semester.
